svg.text: The Complete Agent Runtime — End to End
Six layers · two process types · five execution nouns · six ports · one narrow waist · and the evolution loop that edits the harness around it

g.text: kernel — you do not write this
ports and edge — code you write

svg.text: SURFACE
chat · IDE · inbox · dashboard · CLI · webhook · a schedule · another agent — anything may raise a goal
you already have it
(1) goal · approval · signal
(B) progress — never durable
EDGE
stateless · EDGE PROCESS · holds nothing across a request
no loop · no consumer · no model call
INBOUND — intent · durable · idempotent
auth → tenancy → rate limit → validate → idempotency key
OUTBOUND — view · fast · disposable
hydrate from a read model, THEN subscribe with a cursor
(2) command + (3) event — ONE transaction
(6) read model query
SUBSTRATE
one transactional database · one queue · nothing else
off the shelf

g.text: a replan writes new rows, edits none
has this already run, and cost what?

svg.text: (4) relay CLAIMS a batch — one in flight per partition, no cursor exists
KERNEL
the part you do not write · WORKER PROCESS · horizontally scalable, lease + CAS ensures exactly one driver per run at any instant
RELAY
claims rows, never a cursor
FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
one in flight per partition
N workers · zero coordination
a poison event blocks one
partition, never everyone
(5) ROUTED BY
LATENCY CLASS
FAST QUEUE
decisions · grading · 8–16
SLOW QUEUE
tools + models · 4–6
RUN DRIVER — the EPISODE
(6) claim lease + version CAS, read state
advance N steps · checkpoint after each
read pending signals in the same transaction
holds NO connection across a model call
exit on E1 wall clock · E2 step budget
E3 durable park · E4 signal arrived
step budget = 1 reproduces strict per-step execution
ACTIVITY RUNNER — the QUARANTINE
(8) claim by id → reserve budget → acquire a slot
→ run → settle → append the result event
ALL non-determinism lives in here
id = hash(run_id, plan_id, step_id, tool_id, input_digest)
computed at PLAN time · a finished activity REPLAYS,
it never re-spends · a partial match is an ALERT
SWEEPER
a cron, not a subsystem — expired run leases · expired activity leases · stale relay claims · attempt cap → dead letter
(C) recovery is CONTINUOUS, never only at boot
a worker that sweeps once at start will never notice the run that was stranded four hours in
(A) signals — steer · cancel · pause · answer — read at every checkpoint, and delivered mid-activity by notification
a steer is a goal amendment: it forces a REPLAN, which mints a new plan id, so no stale activity result can be inherited
target: under two seconds from the click to the model call actually stopping
(9) planner + grader on the fast queue (10) tool → model on the slow queue, abort signal reaches all the way down
PORTS
the six things you write — the ENTIRE extension surface. If what you need to change is not one of these six, this architecture is wrong for your product.
THE HARNESS lives at this layer: system prompt · tool description · tool implementation · middleware · skill · sub-agent config · long-term memory
this band, and only this band, is what the evolution loop at the foot of the page is allowed to edit
GATE
(11) an effectful step is STRUCTURALLY UNCALLABLE until a human decision is recorded — enforced in the runner, never by instructing the model.
the run PARKS here, holding nothing
(12) truth + event
YOUR DOMAIN
aggregates · invariants · your own tables — a repo, a ledger, a CRM, a catalogue, a case file
every mutation arrives as an idempotent command · every change appends its event in the same transaction · no run state ever lives here
DELETE THE ENTIRE RUNTIME AND THIS LAYER STILL COMPILES — if it does not, the two have merged and every invariant on the right is unenforceable
(12) the cycle closes: the domain's event is appended to the outbox and re-enters at wire (4). There is no terminating branch and no outer loop in code — the loop is the data.
COMMANDS — imperative, idempotency key, flow DOWN
EVENTS — past tense, same transaction, flow UP
WIRE REFERENCE — follow the numbers once and you have the system

g.text: A goal arrives. A person, a schedule, a webhook, or another agent may raise one.
The edge writes a command through the port. A duplicate key replays the prior result rather than acting twice.
The state change and its event are appended in ONE transaction — the transactional outbox.
The relay claims a batch, one in flight per partition. No cursor exists, so no cursor can drift.
Events are routed by latency class. Cheap decisions and slow tool calls never share a queue.
A run driver wakes, takes the lease, reads state, and runs an episode.
A step needing a tool is enqueued as an activity. The driver does not wait; it checkpoints and lets go.
The runner picks it up on the slow queue, under a model semaphore and a per-tenant admission cap.
The driver calls your planner and your grader. Both are cheap and run on the fast queue.
The runner calls your tool, which calls your model. The abort signal reaches all the way down.
An effectful step issues a command — and only after its gate has been resolved.
Your domain writes truth and appends its event. The cycle closes at wire 4.
Signals: steer, cancel, pause, answer. Read at every checkpoint; delivered mid-activity by notification.
Progress: telemetry straight to the client. Never written to the outbox — it is not a fact.
Recovery: expired leases and stale claims are swept continuously, never only at boot.

svg.text: THE FIVE NOUNS — AND THE CUSTODY GRADIENT
Scarcity × duration is held roughly constant.
Every custody violation is one noun moved up and to the right.
1 Run : N Episodes, sequential and never concurrent
1 Episode : 1–8 Steps, bounded by the step budget
1 Step : 0–1 Activity · 1 Activity : 0–N executions, exactly 1 billed
At steady state roughly three quarters of runs are parked and fewer
than 3% are executing. Size workers for the executing population.
THE RUN STATE MACHINE
Illegal transitions, enforced in code:
· anything → EXECUTING without a committed plan
· PARKED → EXECUTING without a resolution event
· any terminal state → any other state
FOUR CATEGORIES OF STATE — ONE OWNER EACH

g.text: the merged branch, the invoice, the customer record
permanent · strong and invariant-guarded · survives deleting the runtime
current step, plan, lease, attempts, budget spent, short-term memory
ends with the run · checkpointed and recoverable · gone on deletion, correctly
MODEL — what does the model see right now?
the assembled context, cache prefix, token budget
one call · DERIVED, so never persisted as truth — persist it and replay breaks
HARNESS — what has the system learned to do?
long-term memory, prompts, tools, middleware, skills
outlives the run, is not domain truth, and is scoped by NOTHING by default

svg.text: Harness state must be true of the SYSTEM, never of a customer.
NINE INVARIANTS — each checkable by pointing at code

g.text: No work lives in a process. State is a row; a worker
is a temporary reader of it.
Exactly one driver advances a run at any instant,
enforced by a lease and a version check.
No connection and no lock is held across a model or
network call — ever, under any refactor.
All non-determinism lives inside activities, so
orchestration is a function of state and events.
A result is reused only on a full identity match
including the plan. A replan inherits no stale work.
A deadline aborts the real call. Abandoning the
caller leaks the work and lets its effects land later.
An effectful tool is uncallable without a resolved
approval — in the runner, never by prompting.
No run state on a domain aggregate; no domain truth in the run.

svg.text: THE OUTER LOOP — AGENTIC HARNESS ENGINEERING · the base model is held FIXED and only the harness above is edited
I · COMPONENT OBSERVABILITY
THE HARNESS, AS FILES
one failure pattern → one component class
one edit → one commit → file-level rollback
measured: memory, tools and middleware carry
the gain — the system prompt alone regresses
ROLLOUT
the runtime above, run over
a task set, k times per task
a fresh isolated sandbox per
rollout, so side effects
cannot leak between tasks
infrastructure-aborted trials
COUNT AS FAILURES
your failure semantics become
the loop's reward shaping
II · EXPERIENCE OBSERVABILITY
AGENT DEBUGGER
raw trajectories
~10M tokens
distil
evidence corpus
~10K tokens
trajectories as a navigable file environment · progressive disclosure
per-task root-cause reports → one benchmark-level overview
the evolver consumes structured root causes, never raw logs
separate machine time from PARKED time before attributing
anything — human latency is not a property of the harness
III · DECISION OBSERVABILITY
EVOLVE AGENT · CHANGE MANIFEST
next round intersects predictions with observed task deltas
verdict → KEEP · IMPROVE · ROLLBACK AND PIVOT
fix predictions land ~5× above chance —
but regression predictions only ~2×. The loop is blind sideways.
edit the harness — and ONLY the harness
CONTROLLABILITY — the evolve agent writes only inside the harness workspace
the runs directory, the tracer, the verifier and the model configuration are all read-only. It never touches the kernel, the substrate, or your domain.
Without that boundary an unconstrained self-modifier disables the verifier or raises the reasoning budget, and no recorded gain is attributable to anything.
WHY THIS BAND EXISTS
The optimal harness is specific
to a base model, and must be
re-adapted when that model
changes. Models ship faster than
a manual loop can keep up with.
The bottleneck is observability,
not agent capability.
Components interact NON-
ADDITIVELY. Three individually
positive edits summing to +11.1
points delivered +7.3 together.
Evolution is not a layer you add
on top. It is a payoff you become
eligible for by building the
runtime above it correctly.
Next-Generation Autonomous AI Agent Architecture Handbook — master reference figure. The runtime stack is developed in Chapters 4 to 9; the nouns in Chapter 5; state
separation in Chapter 6; the edge in Chapter 7; gates and human authority in Chapter 30; the invariants throughout Level 3; and the evolution band across Level 5.
Sources: runtime structure, ports, invariants and wire reference after A Durable Agent Runtime v1.0 · evolution band after Agentic Harness Engineering (Lin, Liu, Pan et al.) · synthesis, the custody
gradient, the four state categories and the harness-state boundary are the handbook's own engineering inference.
